name: WebWeby Floating Contact Button
author: webweby

sections.description:
WebWeby Floating Contact Button is a lightweight standalone plugin that adds a floating WhatsApp contact button to your website.

Visitors can start a WhatsApp conversation with one click. This helps businesses, agencies, stores, restaurants, clinics, freelancers, and service providers make communication faster and easier.

The plugin does not add a new item to the WordPress left admin menu. Settings are available from the Settings link on the Installed Plugins page.

Features

  • Floating chat and call contact button
  • Custom phone number
  • Custom pre-filled message
  • Left or right button position
  • Desktop visibility control
  • Mobile visibility control
  • Responsive design
  • Lightweight frontend output
  • Inline SVG icon
  • No external icon library required
  • No external WebWeby framework required
  • Translation-ready strings
  • POT file included

Use Cases

  • Business websites
  • Corporate websites
  • Restaurants
  • Medical clinics
  • Dentists
  • Freelancers
  • Agencies
  • Online stores
  • Service providers
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/webweby-floating-contact-button/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  4. Find webweby-floating-contact-button and click Settings.
  5. Enter your WhatsApp number in international format.
  6. Optionally enter a default message.
  7. Choose the button position and visibility settings.
  8. Save settings.
  9. Visit your website to see the floating chat and call button.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin add a left admin menu item?

No. The plugin does not add anything to the WordPress left admin menu. You can open the settings page from the Settings link on the Installed Plugins page.

Does this plugin require another WebWeby plugin?

No. This is a standalone plugin. It does not require any external WebWeby core, framework, or menu loader plugin.

Does this plugin require Font Awesome?

No. The plugin uses an inline SVG icon and does not load Font Awesome or any external icon library.

Does this plugin require a business account?

No. It works with standard and business messaging accounts.

What phone number format should I use?

Use international format without spaces, plus signs, or symbols.

Example:

905551234567

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The plugin is responsive and works on both desktop and mobile devices.

Can I hide the button on desktop or mobile?

Yes. Visibility can be configured separately for desktop and mobile devices.

Can this plugin be translated?

Yes. The plugin includes translation-ready strings and a POT file in the /languages/ directory.
